decisions.reason: The modular waste processing concept builds on Doppstadt's core recycling know-how and already shows a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, so the firm can interpret results and refine it with its own R&D.
A mobile slow-speed shredder sits at the heart of the firm's established competence and has a page of its own, so the firm can readily learn from market feedback and improve it.

This second modular plant concept is related to existing knowledge and supported by in-house R&D and research cooperation, though its lower visibility and overlap with Product A carry some risk of consolidation.
Mobile trommel screens are close to the firm's core offer, so its absorptive capacity lets it assimilate early results and develop the product further.
